name: InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72
insider_take: Soaring above Hanoi's skyline in Vietnam's tallest building, this luxury high-rise delivers breathtaking city views with unmatched elegance.
whats_special: Located in the iconic Landmark72 tower - Vietnam's tallest skyscraper at 336 meters - this InterContinental occupies floors 49-65, making it one of the highest hotels in Southeast Asia. The building's distinctive twisted design creates unique panoramic views from every room, while the hotel's Sky Bar on the 65th floor offers unparalleled vistas of the Red River and Hanoi's ancient quarters.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing east for stunning sunrise views over West Lake and the historic Old Quarter - the higher floors offer crystal-clear sightlines to Hanoi's famous pagodas and temples.
dont_miss: The hotel's infinity pool on the 63rd floor creates the illusion of swimming above the clouds, while the building's observation deck provides 360-degree views of Vietnam's capital. The nearby Keangnam Hanoi Landmark Tower houses luxury shopping and connects directly to the hotel via sky bridge.
pros: Spectacular panoramic city views from one of Hanoi's tallest buildings
Premium location in modern business district with excellent connectivity
Luxurious accommodations with contemporary design and high-end amenities
World-class dining options and rooftop experiences
cons: Located away from Hanoi's historic Old Quarter
